title: Suspicious PsExec service install + LSASS access
description: EDR observed PSEXESVC.exe launching cmd.exe → powershell.exe -enc on fin-app-03, followed by lsass.exe access from C:\Windows\Temp\update.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1010 (Mimikatz-class pattern). Initial admin-alice session originated from external IP 198.51.100.7 via RDP onto jump-host-02 minutes earlier.
